Reviewed `git show HEAD`: the change replaces the `xdg.configFile` store
symlink for herdr/config.toml with a `home.activation.herdrConfig` step
(`lib.hm.dag.entryAfter [ "writeBoundary" ]`) that runs `rm -f` on the target
path before `install -Dm0644 ${checkedConfig} ...`. This matches the commit
message: the rm -f clears a stale symlink from prior generations so install
cannot write through it into the store, the copy is a plain `install` of a
regular store-output file (not a symlink target, so no follow-into-store
risk), and entryAfter "writeBoundary" places it correctly after home-manager's
own file-linking phase, mirroring the existing herdrClaudeIntegration
activation script in modules/user/herdr-claude-home.nix. The `run` wrapper
used here is home-manager's own bash helper (lib/bash/home-manager.sh),
which already gates on `-v DRY_RUN` internally, so the omission of an
explicit `$DRY_RUN_CMD` prefix is consistent with the sibling activation
script in this same repo and not a defect. No correctness concerns found.
